title: AI-generated advice as a reinforcement layer in climate-smart agriculture
title_primary: AI-generated advice as a reinforcement layer in climate-smart agriculture
authors: Callum Alexander, Aiora Zabala, Andreas Kontoleon, Shalamar Armstrong, Anuoluwa Sangotayo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate-smart agricultural (CSA) practices are central to food-system decarbonisation, yet adoption often falls short of farmers’ stated intentions, weakening the impact of incentives and extension under capacity constraints. We test whether spatially targeted, AI-generated advice can narrow this intention-action gap in a randomised field experiment with 1529 row crop farmers in Iowa, Illinois and Indiana during the cover crop decision window. Farmers assigned to receive four AI-generated emails were 4.45 %age points more likely to plant cover crops than controls (z = 2.81, p = 0.005), despite high baseline intentions in both groups. Effects operated on the extensive margin: there was no detectable change in the share of land planted among adopters. Survey responses indicate high engagement and a shift from untested optimism to more calibrated trust after exposure. Supervised AI advice can provide a low-cost, scalable complement to existing extension, improving follow-through and modestly expanding uptake without displacing human expertise.

title: Why we spend so much time in meetings
title_zh: 我们为何在会议上花费如此多时间
title_primary: 我们为何在会议上花费如此多时间
title_secondary: Why we spend so much time in meetings
authors: David Deming, Katrine Løken, Alexander Willén, Yaling Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Few features of modern work are as widely criticised as meetings. Using data from over 9,000 workers in Norway, this column examines how meetings are organised and their effects on firm outcomes. The average worker in our survey spends 4.7 hours per week in meetings, with managers and professionals spending substantially more time in them than other workers. Meetings are substantially more common at firms with higher wage premia and higher revenue, while workers who spend more time in meetings experience faster wage growth, suggesting that meetings provide opportunities to exchange information and knowledge that may benefit not only the firm, but also the workers who participate in them.
abstract_zh: 现代工作中，很少有哪个环节像会议这样广受诟病。本文利用来自挪威9000多名员工的数据，考察会议是如何组织的，以及会议对企业产出的影响。在我们的调查中，普通员工每周花在会议上的时间为4.7小时，而管理者和专业人士花在会议上的时间远多于其他员工。在工资溢价更高、收入更高的企业中，会议明显更为普遍；同时，花更多时间开会的员工工资增长更快，这表明会议提供了交流信息和知识的机会，这不仅可能使企业受益，也可能使参与会议的员工受益。

title: The network origins of China’s economic fluctuations: Firm-level evidence
title_zh: 中国经济波动的网络起源：企业层面证据
title_primary: 中国经济波动的网络起源：企业层面证据

authors: Dazhong Cheng, Yutong Tang, Zhiguo Xiao
official: 官方在线 2026-09-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies how production and supply chain networks shape output growth fluctuations in China. Using a large-scale firm-level supply chain network dataset and conventional input–output tables, we show that higher network centrality is associated with larger output fluctuations, while greater network symmetry is associated with lower volatility. More productive and export-oriented firms or sectors tend to fluctuate less. A quantitative exercise further suggests that observed network heterogeneity can amplify micro-level disturbances into aggregate growth volatility, generating non-normal aggregate outcomes even from light-tailed micro shocks.

title: 耐用品价格补贴与家庭消费行为：家电以旧换新的证据

abstract: 耐用品价格补贴的消费激励效应,是理解居民消费行为、畅通国内大循环的重要切口。本文聚焦上一轮家电以旧换新政策,利用城镇住户调查细分记账数据,系统考察其对家庭总消费、家电购买及消费结构的影响。研究发现：政策实施当年和后续年份,家庭总消费分别增加2262元和4793元,对应需求弹性为0.52和1.10;政策显著促进五类补贴家电消费,家电消费增长更接近更新替换而非存量扩张;政策还带动家庭服务、通信、文娱服务等消费,对医疗保健、成人教育和保险支出形成有限挤出;政策主要影响了中高收入、高教育和劳动年龄家庭。本文从微观家庭层面厘清耐用品价格补贴的消费传导逻辑,为新一轮促消费政策的优化设计提供实证依据。

title: Public Enforcement and Initial Public Offering Reporting Quality in Weak Institutional Environments: Evidence from a Random Experiment in China
title_zh: 弱制度环境下的公共执法与IPO报告质量：来自中国随机实验的证据
title_primary: 弱制度环境下的公共执法与IPO报告质量：来自中国随机实验的证据
title_secondary: Public Enforcement and Initial Public Offering Reporting Quality in Weak Institutional Environments: Evidence from a Random Experiment in China
authors: Manyi Fan, Kai Guo, Bin Ke
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using China’s randomized pre-initial public offering on-site inspection program, we examine the causal effects of proactive public enforcement on the financial reporting quality of initial public offering applicants. Our analysis shows that the program enhances the reporting quality of selected applicants by screening out firms with questionable financial disclosures. More importantly, it generates a significant deterrence effect, discouraging future applicants from submitting low-quality financial reports. However, we also find that public enforcement can lead to the rejection of some firms that may otherwise merit approval. These findings highlight both the benefits and costs of employing public enforcement to improve financial reporting in settings with weak institutional oversight. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: K. Guo acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72302146 and 72132006], the Shanghai Pujiang Program, and the National Social Science Fund of China [Grant 22AZD034]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042 .
abstract_zh: 利用中国随机性的首次公开募股前现场检查项目，我们考察了主动公共执法对首次公开募股申请人财务报告质量的因果效应。我们的分析表明，该项目通过筛选出财务披露存在问题的企业，提升了被选中申请人的报告质量。更重要的是，它产生了显著的威慑效应，阻止未来申请人提交低质量的财务报告。然而，我们也发现公共执法可能导致一些本应获得批准的企业被拒绝。这些发现凸显了在制度监督薄弱的环境中，利用公共执法改善财务报告所带来的益处与成本。本文被会计学编辑Eric So接受。资金支持：K. Guo感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72302146和72132006]、上海浦江计划及国家社会科学基金[批准号22AZD034]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042获取。

title: What the Iran War Teaches Us about the Price Elasticity of Oil Supply
title_zh: 伊朗战争对石油供给价格弹性的启示
title_primary: 伊朗战争对石油供给价格弹性的启示
title_secondary: What the Iran War Teaches Us about the Price Elasticity of Oil Supply
authors: Lutz Kilian, Kunal Patel
official: 官方在线 2026-08-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We draw on evidence from the 2026 Iran War to assess the validity of estimates of the short-run price elasticity of oil supply reported in the literature. Our analysis confirms that the one-month and one-quarter U.S. oil supply elasticity is effectively zero, consistent with estimates in Newell and Prest (2019). The data strongly reject the much higher elasticity estimates reported by more recent studies. This finding is consistent with evidence from surveys of oil company executives and with industry data about how long it takes to complete a well and start pumping oil. It is also consistent with theoretical arguments that the short-run oil supply elasticity is zero if adjusting oil production is costly, as is the case in practice. Our results have important implications for the construction and credibility of structural VAR models of the global oil market.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2026年伊朗战争的证据，评估文献中报告的石油供给短期价格弹性估计的有效性。我们的分析证实，美国石油供给的一个月和一季度弹性实际上为零，这与纽厄尔和普雷斯特（2019）的估计一致。数据强烈否定了近期研究报告的更高弹性估计。这一发现与对石油公司高管的调查证据以及关于完成一口井并开始抽油所需时间的行业数据相符。同时，它也支持理论论点，即如果调整石油生产是有成本的（实际情况正是如此），那么短期石油供给弹性为零。我们的结果对全球石油市场结构性VAR模型的构建和可信度具有重要意义。

title: Does energy infrastructure modernization drive manufacturing quality? Micro-evidence from China's ultra-high voltage projects
title_zh: 能源基础设施现代化是否推动制造业质量提升？——来自中国特高压项目的微观证据
title_primary: 能源基础设施现代化是否推动制造业质量提升？——来自中国特高压项目的微观证据
title_secondary: Does energy infrastructure modernization drive manufacturing quality? Micro-evidence from China's ultra-high voltage projects
authors: Boqiang Lin, Jie Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Large-scale energy infrastructure is a fundamental policy instrument for ensuring industrial resilience and promoting high-quality development. Using ultra-high-voltage (UHV) construction as a natural experiment and merging the National Tax Survey with China's Customs Import and Export Database, this paper examines how improved electricity supply affects firms' product quality. Results show that: 1. UHV construction significantly improves product quality in affected regions, suggesting that grid modernization can generate micro-level quality-upgrading effects. 2. Product-level analysis reveals that firms not only upgrade overall product quality, but also channel additional resources toward newly added products, whose quality, export quantity, and price increase after UHV construction. Meanwhile, UHV construction reduces the quality and quantity disadvantages of discontinued products relative to other products within the same firm, indicating a shortboard-mitigating effect. 3. Further analysis shows that UHV construction is associated with higher firm electricity consumption and lower output volatility. The quality-improving effect is significant in electricity-importing regions but not in electricity-exporting regions, and is stronger among firms with higher electricity dependence, stronger capital utilization capacity, and greater R&D investment. This study provides micro-empirical evidence for the “quality-improving effect” of grid modernization and offers policy insights for optimizing electricity resource allocation to support a sustainable industrial transition.
abstract_zh: 大规模能源基础设施是保障产业韧性与推动高质量发展的重要政策工具。本文以特高压（UHV）建设作为自然实验，将全国税收调查数据与中国海关进出口数据库相匹配，考察电力供应改善如何影响企业产品质量。结果表明：第一，特高压建设显著提升了受影响地区的产品质量，说明电网现代化能够产生微观层面的质量升级效应。第二，产品层面分析发现，企业不仅提升了整体产品质量，还将更多资源投向新增产品，这些产品在特高压建设后其质量、出口数量和价格均有所提高。同时，特高压建设缩小了停产产品相对于同一企业内其他产品的质量与数量劣势，表明其具有补短板效应。第三，进一步分析表明，特高压建设与企业更高的用电量和更低的产出波动相关。质量提升效应在电力输入地区显著，而在电力输出地区不显著，并且在电力依赖度更高、资本利用能力更强以及研发投入更多的企业中更为明显。本研究为电网现代化的“质量提升效应”提供了微观经验证据，并为优化电力资源配置以支持可持续产业转型提供了政策启示。

title: Partisan conflict and economic policy uncertainty: insights from a time-varying causality approach
title_zh: 党派冲突与经济政策不确定性：基于时变因果方法的洞察
title_primary: 党派冲突与经济政策不确定性：基于时变因果方法的洞察
title_secondary: Partisan conflict and economic policy uncertainty: insights from a time-varying causality approach
authors: Nikolaos Antonakakis, Menbere Workie Tiruneh, David Gabauer, Samuel R. Schubert, Lemonia Papadopoulou-Kelidou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How does partisan conflict (PC) relate to economic policy uncertainty (EPU)? When does uncertainty feed back into conflict, and how stable is that link? We examine these dynamics using a time-varying Granger causality framework applied to United States monthly data from 1985 to 2025, combining the PC Index with aggregate and disaggregated EPU subindices. PC consistently precedes spikes in fiscal, tax, spending, and health care uncertainty. In contrast, the predictive direction reverses mainly during large shocks, such as trade conflicts or financial regulation crises, and largely disappears during recessions. Generalised forecast error variance decompositions show that PC shocks account for a modest but non trivial share of forecast error variance in fiscal, tax, spending, and health care uncertainty, while policy shocks in trade and regulatory domains explain a much larger share of the variance in partisan conflict itself. These results reveal asymmetric, time-varying predictive linkages between political polarization and policy uncertainty. The findings, which are based on the decomposition of EPU into its components and time-varying Granger causality, contribute to theories of veto players, gridlock, and signaling by identifying the institutional conditions under which political conflict is associated with greater economic volatility and when policy uncertainty appears to reinforce partisan division.
abstract_zh: 党派冲突（PC）与经济政策不确定性（EPU）之间存在何种关联？不确定性何时会反馈至冲突之中，且这一联系的稳定性如何？我们运用时变格兰杰因果框架，结合美国1985年至2025年的月度数据，将PC指数与总体及分项EPU子指数相结合，对上述动态进行了考察。PC始终先于财政、税收、支出及医疗保健领域不确定性的飙升。相反，预测方向主要在大规模冲击期间发生逆转，如贸易冲突或金融监管危机，并在经济衰退期间基本消失。广义预测误差方差分解显示，PC冲击对财政、税收、支出及医疗保健不确定性预测误差方差的贡献虽适度但不可忽视，而贸易和监管领域的政策冲击则解释了党派冲突自身预测误差方差的更大份额。这些结果揭示了政治极化与政策不确定性之间非对称、时变的预测关联。基于EPU分项分解及时变格兰杰因果的发现，通过识别政治冲突与经济波动加剧相关联的制度条件，以及政策不确定性似乎强化党派分歧的情境，为否决者、僵局及信号传递理论作出了贡献。

title: What Do Impact Investors Do Differently?*
title_zh: 影响力投资者有何不同？*
title_primary: 影响力投资者有何不同？*
title_secondary: What Do Impact Investors Do Differently?*
authors: Shawn Cole, Leslie Jeng, Josh Lerner, Natalia Rigol, Benjamin N Roth
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do impact investors seek impact, or merely “impact wash”? We provide systematic evidence on the nonfinancial determinants of impact investing. Impact investors focus on firms aligned with the priorities of the federal government and disproportionately invest in economically disadvantaged regions. While we find high levels of coinvestment between impact and traditional investors, we also show that impact investors influence the strategies of their traditional coinvestors, are more likely to fund firms in nascent industries, and invest countercyclically. Finally, we characterize investment heterogeneity based on a novel classification of impact investment theses, with a focus on climate, environment, and jobs and equity.
abstract_zh: 影响力投资者是在追求影响力，还是仅仅在“洗影响力”？我们提供了关于影响力投资非财务决定因素的系统性证据。影响力投资者聚焦于与联邦政府优先事项一致的企业，并不成比例地投资于经济欠发达地区。尽管我们发现影响力投资者与传统投资者之间存在高水平的联合投资，但我们也表明，影响力投资者会影响其传统联合投资者的策略，更倾向于资助新兴行业中的企业，并进行逆周期投资。最后，我们基于对影响力投资主题的新分类，重点关注气候、环境以及就业与公平，刻画了投资的异质性。

title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
title_zh: 储备与最后买家
title_primary: 储备与最后买家
title_secondary: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
authors: Frederic Boissay, Harald Uhlig
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a ``market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备有助于中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任政策下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性降低冻结风险的作用。我们提出了一项“市场后盾原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则结合了状态依存的最后买家干预措施以恢复交易，并辅以适度的流动性要求以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。我们探讨了这对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的影响。

title: Beyond the aid model: innovating university-community partnerships in remote rural China
title_zh: 超越援助模式：中国偏远农村地区大学-社区伙伴关系的创新
title_primary: 超越援助模式：中国偏远农村地区大学-社区伙伴关系的创新
title_secondary: Beyond the aid model: innovating university-community partnerships in remote rural China
authors: Xun Li, Luan Chen, Ye Long, Xianyu Hou, Jin Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Why do so many well-intentioned aid programs in remote areas fail to bring durable outcomes? A common explanation attributes failure to local communities’ lack of knowledge or capacity. This paper argues instead that dependency is embedded in the one-directional structure of aid itself. As an alternative, it introduces a university-community co-practice model that fosters two-way collaboration and integrates external resources into villagers’ everyday practices, through which cognitive, relational, and structural forms of social capital are generated. Drawing on more than five years of action research in two villages in southwestern China, the study shows how universities and villagers collaborated in a paired assistance program to renovate houses and courtyards through hands-on co-practice and mutual learning. These small-scale interventions not only improved living conditions but also enabled villagers to maintain and adapt the initiatives after external experts withdrew. The findings suggest that the university-community partnerships can transform short-term aid into more equitable and resilient rural development by embedding development processes in locally grounded networks of social capital.
abstract_zh: 为什么许多在偏远地区用意良好的援助项目未能带来持久成果？一种常见解释将其归咎于当地社区缺乏知识或能力。本文则认为，依赖性根植于援助本身单向性的结构之中。作为替代方案，本文引入了一种大学与社区共同实践的模型，该模型促进双向合作，并将外部资源融入村民的日常实践中，由此生成认知性、关系性和结构性的社会资本。基于在中国西南两个村庄开展的五年多行动研究，本研究展示了大学与村民如何在结对帮扶项目中通过动手共同实践和相互学习来翻新房屋与庭院。这些小型干预不仅改善了居住条件，还使村民在外部专家撤离后能够维持并调整这些举措。研究结果表明，大学与社区的伙伴关系能够通过将发展过程嵌入基于地方的社会资本网络中，将短期援助转化为更为公平且具有韧性的农村发展。

abstract: A firm’s gross margin increases by 0.8 p.p.after forming a new direct board connection to a product market peer. Gross margin also rises by 0.4 p.p.after a connection is formed to a peer indirectly through a third intermediate firm. Further, using barcode-level data of 2.7 million products, we show that new board connections are related to higher consumer good prices, a greater tendency for market allocation, and slower new product introductions. The effects are stronger when the newly connected peers share corporate customers or have similar business descriptions and hold when controlling for other inter-firm relationships.

title: The international RBC model finally works!
title_zh: 国际真实经济周期模型终于奏效了！
title_primary: 国际真实经济周期模型终于奏效了！
title_secondary: The international RBC model finally works!
authors: Sushant Acharya, Edouard Challe, Louphou Coulibaly
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies---which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量角度解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：(i) 巴克斯-史密斯谜题、(ii) 巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及(iii) 贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能够同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有这些谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

title: Land-use change and long-term socioeconomic outcomes: Studying over six decades of global data (1960–2023)
title_zh: 土地利用变化与长期社会经济结果：基于1960–2023年全球数据的六十年研究
title_primary: 土地利用变化与长期社会经济结果：基于1960–2023年全球数据的六十年研究
title_secondary: Land-use change and long-term socioeconomic outcomes: Studying over six decades of global data (1960–2023)
authors: Daria Loginova, Stefan Mann, Sabine Hoidn, Ioannis Varvaris
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land Use, Land-Use Change, and Forestry (LULUCF) dynamics are often evaluated primarily through environmental and ecological perspectives, yet their long-term socioeconomic outcomes remain underexplored. This study analyses global data from 1960 to 2023 to examine how changes in key LULUCF indicators – such as forest area, agricultural land, arable land, and permanent cropland – are linked to socioeconomic indicators across fifteen thematic domains, with time lags ranging from one to ten years. Drawing on longitudinal World Bank datasets, this study uses time-series analyses to capture significant linkages and temporal dynamics. The results reveal significant correlations between past land-use changes and later socioeconomic outcomes, including unexpected links to gender equality, health outcomes, and financial and employment indicators, alongside more conventional connections with Gross Domestic Product, trade, and education. These findings underscore the complex interplay between land-use decisions and socioeconomic dynamics at the country level, emphasising the need for integrated land-use policies that weigh short-term economic gains against long-term social and economic objectives. By demonstrating land use as a strategic lever for achieving equitable, resilient, and sustainable development, this study offers actionable insights to support strategies that jointly advance environmental goals – including climate and ecological targets – and foster lasting socioeconomic progress at local, regional, national, European and global scales.
abstract_zh: 土地利用、土地利用变化与林业（LULUCF）动态通常主要从环境和生态视角进行评估，但其长期社会经济后果仍未得到充分探讨。本研究分析了1960年至2023年的全球数据，考察关键LULUCF指标——如森林面积、农业用地、耕地和永久性作物用地——的变化如何与十五个主题领域的社会经济指标相关联，时间滞后范围从一年到十年不等。利用世界银行纵向数据集，本研究采用时间序列分析以捕捉显著关联及时间动态。结果显示，过去的土地利用变化与后续社会经济结果之间存在显著相关性，包括与性别平等、健康结果以及金融和就业指标的意外关联，同时也有与国内生产总值、贸易和教育相关的更为传统的联系。这些发现强调了国家层面土地利用决策与社会经济动态之间复杂的相互作用，凸显了制定综合土地利用政策的必要性，此类政策需权衡短期经济收益与长期社会和经济目标。通过证明土地利用作为实现公平、有韧性和可持续发展战略杠杆的作用，本研究提供了可操作的见解，以支持协同推进环境目标——包括气候和生态目标——并在地方、区域、国家、欧洲及全球尺度上促进持久社会经济进步的各类战略。

authors: Olena Kostyshyna, Isabelle Salle, Hung Truong

abstract: We develop a behavioural model of inflation which contains an indicator that quantifies the expectations unanchoring risk over the business cycle. We estimate this model using US and Canadian inflation and output gap data. We find that during the post‐pandemic inflation surge, the macroeconomic data are compatible with non mean‐reverting expectations, which reveals an elevated, albeit transitory, risk of expectations drifting away from the target. This risk has fully subsided in Canada but has not yet entirely dissipated in the United States. We find no evidence of such risk on the downside, despite prevailing policy narratives in the 2010s decade.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含指示变量的通胀行为模型，用以量化经济周期中预期脱锚的风险。我们使用美国和加拿大的通胀与产出缺口数据对该模型进行估计。研究发现，在疫情后通胀飙升期间，宏观经济数据与非均值回归预期相容，揭示出预期偏离目标的风险上升，尽管这一风险是暂时性的。该风险在加拿大已完全消退，但在美国尚未完全消散。尽管2010年代的政策叙事普遍存在，我们并未发现下行方向存在此类风险的证据。

title: The impact of introducing a (nearly) redundant security: Evidence from Malaysian corporate bonds
title_zh: 引入（近乎）冗余证券的影响：来自马来西亚公司债券的证据

authors: Antje Berndt, Jean Helwege, Amanda Liu, Frank Packer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model in which firms issue nearly redundant securities to investor clienteles with participation constraints, with prices and demand determined endogenously in primary and secondary markets. The model characterizes how issuance costs, market frictions, and investor composition shape firms’ funding choices, equilibrium prices, and asset allocations. We test the model’s predictions using data from the Malaysian corporate bond market following the introduction of Islamic bonds. Consistent with the model, issuance decisions reflect trade-offs between collateral and liquidity benefits, Islamic and conventional bonds coexist without crowding out, and the expanded investor base increases access to debt financing.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业向面临参与约束的投资者客户群发行近乎冗余的证券，价格和需求在一级市场和二级市场中内生决定。该模型刻画了发行成本、市场摩擦及投资者构成如何塑造企业的融资选择、均衡价格和资产配置。我们利用马来西亚企业债券市场在引入伊斯兰债券后的数据检验了模型的预测。与模型一致，发行决策反映了抵押品与流动性收益之间的权衡，伊斯兰债券与常规债券共存而不相互挤出，且扩大的投资者基础增加了债务融资的可及性。

abstract: We develop a life-cycle model of labor supply and human capital formation that incorporates health shocks, health insurance, and medical treatment decisions. We use the model to study effects of health shocks on health, labor supply, earnings, and earnings inequality. We also simulate provision of public insurance to agents who lack employer-sponsored insurance. While this increases medical spending substantially, it creates positive labor supply incentives for low-skill workers while reducing costs of social insurance, Medicaid, and free care. The net program cost is modest, and all model agents are ex ante better off in a balanced budget simulation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含健康冲击、健康保险及医疗治疗决策的劳动供给与人力资本形成的生命周期模型。利用该模型，我们研究了健康冲击对健康、劳动供给、收入及收入不平等的影响。同时，我们模拟了向缺乏雇主提供保险的个体提供公共保险的情形。尽管这显著增加了医疗支出，但它为低技能工人创造了积极的劳动供给激励，同时降低了社会保险、医疗补助及免费医疗的成本。净项目成本适中，且在平衡预算模拟中，所有模型个体的事前福利均有所改善。

title: When climate risks become evident: A natural experiment on risk perceptions in the housing market
title_zh: 气候风险显现时：住房市场风险认知的自然实验
title_primary: 气候风险显现时：住房市场风险认知的自然实验
title_secondary: When climate risks become evident: A natural experiment on risk perceptions in the housing market
authors: Anders Dugstad, Dag Einar Sommervoll
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate-related disasters can affect housing markets by making previously underappreciated risks more salient. This paper studies how a rare and catastrophic quick-clay landslide in Eastern Norway affects housing market outcomes. The event constituted a double information shock for the housing market: extensive national media coverage sharply increased public attention to quick-clay risk, while the same coverage widely disseminated interactive hazard maps and encouraged people to assess whether their own properties were located in at-risk zones. Using detailed property transaction data from Eastern Norway, we combine a two-way fixed effects difference-in-differences design with boundary-based comparisons of properties located near mapped hazard zones. Properties exposed to quick-clay risk experience statistically significant price declines of 1–1.5 percent relative to non-exposed properties, with effects extending beyond the directly affected municipality. Event-study estimates show that the response is temporary, reflecting a short-lived adjustment in risk perceptions. Applying these event-study estimates to exposed properties sold in Eastern Norway during the two-year response period implies a capitalization loss of approximately USD 23 million. We find little indication of effects on transaction volumes, but new residential development in quick-clay risk zones appears to fall by roughly 12 percent. Overall, the findings show that even a highly visible fatal disaster generates a detectable but limited and short-lived housing market response.
abstract_zh: 气候相关灾害可能通过使先前未被充分认识的风险变得更加显著而影响住房市场。本文研究挪威东部一次罕见且灾难性的快黏土滑坡如何影响住房市场结果。该事件对住房市场构成了双重信息冲击：全国性媒体的广泛报道急剧提升了公众对快黏土风险的关注，同时这些报道广泛传播了交互式灾害地图，并鼓励人们评估自己的房产是否位于风险区域内。利用挪威东部的详细房产交易数据，我们将双向固定效应双重差分设计与基于边界的地块比较相结合，比较位于已绘制灾害区域附近的地块。暴露于快黏土风险的房产相对于未暴露房产，价格出现统计上显著的1%至1.5%的下降，且影响延伸至直接受灾市镇之外。事件研究估计显示，这一反应是暂时的，反映了风险认知中的短期调整。将这些事件研究估计应用于挪威东部两年响应期内出售的暴露房产，意味着资本化损失约为2300万美元。我们发现对交易量影响的迹象甚微，但快黏土风险区域内的新建住宅开发似乎下降了约12%。总体而言，研究结果表明，即使是一场高度可见的致命灾害，也只会引发可检测但有限且短暂的住房市场反应。

abstract: This paper examines the evolution of strategies in repeated 2 x 2 anti-coordination games. Turn-taking is advantageous against strategies that consistently choose the same stage-game action, provided the discount factor is sufficiently high or the payoff asymmetry in coordination is sufficiently low. However, it becomes vulnerable when the set of strategies allowed to invade is expanded. Nonetheless, if the matching process exhibits a high degree of assortativity, turn-taking regains robustness as long as it promotes efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演变。当贴现因子足够高或协调中的收益不对称性足够低时，轮流选择策略相对于持续选择相同阶段博弈行动的策略具有优势。然而，当允许入侵的策略集合扩大时，这种优势变得脆弱。尽管如此，如果匹配过程表现出高度的同类相配性，只要轮流选择能促进效率，它便能重新获得稳健性。

title_zh: 骗子的遗产：腐败的民俗根源
title_primary: 骗子的遗产：腐败的民俗根源
title_secondary: The trickster’s legacy: The folklore roots of corruption
authors: Jean-Baptiste Marigo, Laurent Weill
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the role of oral traditions in shaping corruption. Using firm-level data on a large sample of 82,922 firms covering 287 cultural societies in 125 countries, we analyze how the representation of antisocial behavior in folklore is associated with corruption. Our findings reveal that societies with folklore portraying antisocial behaviors as successful tend to exhibit higher levels of corruption, while those with oral traditions emphasizing the negative outcomes of such behaviors experience lower corruption. By distinguishing demand- and supply-side corruption channels, we document that folklore is associated with variations in bribe-related decisions, both for firms that are initiators and targets. Thus, our work contributes to the understanding of deep-rooted cultural determinants of corruption.

title: Missing Endogenous Variables in Conditional Moment Restriction Models
title_zh: 条件矩限制模型中缺失内生变量
title_primary: 条件矩限制模型中缺失内生变量
title_secondary: Missing Endogenous Variables in Conditional Moment Restriction Models
authors: Antonio Cosma, Andreï Kostyrka, Gautam Tripathi
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate finite-dimensional parameters in conditional moment restriction (CMR) models when at least one of the endogenous variables (outcomes and/or explanatory variables) in the model is missing for some individuals in the sample. We demonstrate that efficiency gains in estimation occur if and only if there is at least one endogenous variable—included in or excluded from the CMR model—that is nonmissing (observed for all individuals in the sample), which we show characterizes informative imputation. We propose a semiparametrically efficient estimator which is also “doubly robust.” To illustrate the insights our estimator can provide in empirical applications with large sample sizes, we artificially induce missingness in the female labor supply model of Angrist and Evans. Despite medium levels of missingness in female labor income (the outcome) and a sample size exceeding 200,000 observations, the inverse propensity score weighted generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator finds only a statistically insignificant negative effect of having a third child (the endogenous regressor) on labor income. In contrast, our efficient estimator yields point estimates of this effect that are not only comparable to the GMM estimates but are also statistically significant.
abstract_zh: 我们估计条件矩限制（CMR）模型中的有限维参数，此时样本中某些个体的模型内至少有一个内生变量（结果变量和/或解释变量）缺失。我们证明，当且仅当至少存在一个内生变量——无论是包含在CMR模型中还是被排除在CMR模型之外——是非缺失的（即对样本中所有个体均可观测），估计效率才会提升，我们证明这一条件刻画了信息性插补。我们提出一个半参数有效估计量，该估计量同时具有“双重稳健”性。为说明我们的估计量在大样本实证应用中所能提供的洞见，我们在Angrist和Evans的女性劳动供给模型中人为引入缺失。尽管女性劳动收入（结果变量）存在中等程度的缺失，且样本量超过200,000个观测值，逆倾向得分加权广义矩方法（GMM）估计量仅发现生育第三个孩子（内生回归变量）对劳动收入具有统计上不显著的负效应。相比之下，我们的有效估计量给出的该效应点估计不仅与GMM估计值相当，而且具有统计显著性。

title: Strategy-proofness, investment efficiency, and marginal returns: An equivalence
title_zh: 策略证明性、投资效率与边际收益：一个等价性
title_primary: 策略证明性、投资效率与边际收益：一个等价性
title_secondary: Strategy-proofness, investment efficiency, and marginal returns: An equivalence
authors: John William Hatfield, Fuhito Kojima, Scott Duke Kominers
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Drawing on classical insights from mechanism design, we show that ex post efficient mechanisms induce agents to make efficient ex ante investment choices if and only if they are strategy-proof. For mechanisms that fail to be exactly strategy-proof or efficient, we derive a correspondence between the degree of failure of strategy-proofness or efficiency and the degree of failure to induce efficient investment. Our results extend to settings with uncertainty. Additionally, our results imply both that the worker-optimal stable mechanism incentivizes workers to make efficient human capital investments before entering the labor market, and that uniform-price and double auctions induce approximately efficient investment in large markets.
abstract_zh: 借鉴机制设计的经典洞见，我们证明，事后有效机制能诱导代理人做出事前有效投资选择，当且仅当这些机制是策略-proof的。对于不完全策略-proof或效率不足的机制，我们推导出策略-proof性或效率缺失程度与诱导有效投资缺失程度之间的对应关系。我们的结果扩展至不确定性环境。此外，我们的发现还意味着，工人最优稳定机制激励工人在进入劳动力市场前进行有效的人力资本投资，而统一价格拍卖和双向拍卖在大市场中诱导近似有效的投资。

title: Examining residents’ willingness to pay for cultural and ecological heritage preservation: integrating contingent valuation method with fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis
title_zh: 整合条件估值法与模糊集定性比较分析：居民文化与生态遗产保护支付意愿研究
title_primary: 整合条件估值法与模糊集定性比较分析：居民文化与生态遗产保护支付意愿研究
title_secondary: Examining residents’ willingness to pay for cultural and ecological heritage preservation: integrating contingent valuation method with fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis
authors: Guangyu Xiao Choong-Ki Lee James W. Mjelde Jae Ho Lee Dongoh Joo Shiyao Wu a College of Hotel & Tourism Management, Kyung Hee University, Seoul, South Koreab Department of Agricultural Economics, Texas A&M University, College Station, TX 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines residents’ willingness to pay (WTP) to preserve the Cultural Landscape of the Old Tea Forests of Jingmai Mountain in China by combining the contingent valuation method (CVM) with fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (FsQCA). CVM results reveal that tea-drinking habits, sustainable intelligence, cultural worldview, nature-centric views, and income positively influence WTP. Mean annual truncated WTP is estimated to be 204 CNY (US$28.18) per resident, yielding an aggregate preservation value of 490.39 million CNY (US$67.73 million). This value is comprised of bequest (58.8%), existence (23.6%), and option value (17.6%). FsQCA identifies two core pathways towards willingness to pay for preservation: (1) nature-centric views combined with high income, and (2) tea-drinking habits, regardless of income level associated with respondents. FsQCA results suggest that cultural factors can partially override income constraints in preservation valuation decisions. Overall results provide a basis for identifying preservation funding targets and reveal that policymakers can enhance WTP through economic development and cultural reinforcement strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过结合条件价值评估法（CVM）与模糊集定性比较分析（FsQCA），探讨了居民对保护中国景迈山古茶林文化景观的支付意愿（WTP）。CVM结果显示，饮茶习惯、可持续智能、文化世界观、自然中心观及收入对支付意愿有正向影响。年均截断支付意愿估计为每位居民204元人民币（约28.18美元），合计保护价值达4.9039亿元人民币（约6773万美元）。该价值由遗赠价值（58.8%）、存在价值（23.6%）和选择价值（17.6%）构成。FsQCA识别出两条通往保护支付意愿的核心路径：（1）自然中心观与高收入相结合；（2）饮茶习惯，不论受访者收入水平如何。FsQCA结果表明，在保护价值评估决策中，文化因素可在一定程度上超越收入限制。总体结果为实现保护资金目标提供了依据，并揭示政策制定者可通过经济发展与文化强化策略提升支付意愿。

title: The silent squeeze: how China’s New-type urbanization affects firm entry
title_zh: 无声的挤压：中国新型城镇化如何影响企业进入
title_primary: 无声的挤压：中国新型城镇化如何影响企业进入
title_secondary: The silent squeeze: how China’s New-type urbanization affects firm entry
authors: Mai Wang Yuan Li a School of Economics, Peking University, Beijing, Chinab School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development, Renmin University of China, Beijing, China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper employs county-level panel data from 2012 to 2020 and a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) approach to examine the impact of China’s National New-Type Urbanization Plan (NNUP) on firm entry. The findings indicate that the NNUP significantly discourages firm entry through two main channels: first, by increasing enterprise costs due to enhanced worker welfare policies; and second, by intensifying fiscal pressure on local governments because of increased investments in public services. This negative effect exhibits regional heterogeneity depending on strategic orientations and administrative levels. However, the NNUP also fosters positive structural changes by promoting the growth of public service sectors such as education, healthcare, and transportation. The study further reveals that although the NNUP enhances social welfare and sustainability, achieving inclusive economic growth requires striking a balance between urbanization objectives and a business-friendly environment. Specifically, local governments should adopt fiscal diversification strategies and formulate adaptive policies tailored to regional characteristics to ensure sustainable development during the process of urbanization reform and resident welfare enhancement. This research contributes to a deeper understanding of the microeconomic impacts of urbanization, providing valuable insights into urban policy design in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2012至2020年县级面板数据及交错双重差分法，考察了中国新型城镇化规划（NNUP）对企业进入的影响。研究发现，NNUP显著抑制了企业进入，主要通过两个渠道实现：一是通过增强劳动者福利政策提高企业成本；二是因公共服务投资增加加剧了地方政府的财政压力。这一负面效应根据战略导向和行政层级的不同呈现出区域异质性。然而，NNUP也通过促进教育、医疗和交通等公共服务部门的发展，推动了积极的结构性变化。研究进一步揭示，尽管NNUP提升了社会福利和可持续性，实现包容性经济增长仍需在城镇化目标与营商友好环境之间寻求平衡。具体而言，地方政府应采取财政多元化策略，并制定适应区域特点的针对性政策，以确保城镇化改革和居民福利提升过程中的可持续发展。本研究有助于深入理解城镇化的微观经济影响，为发展中经济体的城市政策设计提供了有价值的参考。

title: Does Peer Adoption Increase the Diffusion of Pollution Prevention Practices?
title_zh: 同行采纳是否会增加污染预防实践的扩散？
title_primary: 同行采纳是否会增加污染预防实践的扩散？
title_secondary: Does Peer Adoption Increase the Diffusion of Pollution Prevention Practices?
authors: Bi, X., Mullally, C., Gaonkar, S.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Voluntary adoption of pollution prevention (P2) practices has been used to reduce toxic emissions in the US. Spillovers among facilities owned by the same firm likely play an important role in the diffusion of P2 practices. This article estimates the intrafirm spillover effects of P2 adoption. Using instrumental variables methods applied to facility panel data from the Toxics Release Inventory, we find that a facility’s own adoption of P2 practices increases in response to greater P2 adoption by facilities from the same firm. Intrafirm spillovers are stronger among small firms and firms with higher degree of sibling homophily. JEL Q55Q58
abstract_zh: 美国通过自愿采纳污染预防（P2）实践来减少有毒排放。同一企业旗下设施之间的溢出效应可能在P2实践的扩散中发挥重要作用。本文估计了P2采纳的企业内溢出效应。利用应用于有毒物质排放清单设施面板数据的工具变量方法，我们发现，当同一企业内其他设施采纳P2实践增多时，设施自身采纳P2实践的可能性也随之增加。企业内溢出效应在小企业和兄弟设施同质性较高的企业中更为显著。JEL分类号：Q55，Q58
